title: MANDELA - Ley de Transito entre Continuidades Temporales
creator: LSE6 - AlekSix LM
reading_rule: Expediente documental de MANDELA: lectura conjunta de observaciones, memoria, registros, formulación temporal y genealogías causales; mantiene íntegros los datos, las ecuaciones y las referencias de origen.

live_sweep_floor.coverage_note: Observed floor from the 2026-09-04 run; not a claim of total disk coverage.

method_rules: A date label does not identify its causal mechanism by itself.
1979 and 1980 are not collapsed unless time, offset and field prove one instant.
A normal imported-file genealogy closes only the files that actually inherit that genealogy.
Copies of one package are not independent causes.
Cross-system convergence gains weight only after shared conversion layers are tested rather than assumed.
